notes.title: MOONCHILD DEMO- PATCH 1.003
notes.notes: -Fixed a bug with Analysis that caused it to freeze enemies and thus be able to cheese battles. (Hopefully it works!)

notes.title: ACT 1 DEMO RELEASE DATE!!
notes.notes:
I know, it's been a long while, I'm so sorry for the wait. The MOONCHILD ACT 1 DEMO is finally coming
out, this Sunday!!

Here's a trailer to spread around if you wish (ignore the August date, that ended up being incorrect.)[previewyoutube=eE8xo_2A8fE;full][/previewyoutube]

This demo contains 1/3rd of the full game, providing approximately 6-8 hours of content if you take your time and check out all the little details. All four party members are present.
Testing this was an absolute nightmare at times, but I've finally come through the other side. It'd mean the world if you could spread this around as much as possible!

The world of MOONCHILD awaits you, November 10th!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44150567/bce29c4019c2a2c4c9d6ad40c5d843fdd9871d3e.jpg
